description: Saves the floor layout of a plan (shown in the plan's 🏠 Layout tab, where the user drags furniture). Coordinates in cm from the top-left inner corner of each floor; x to the right, y down. Per floor: name, W, H (inner size), height_cm (ceiling), rooms [{name, label (area text), x, y, w, h, wet, block (stairs/technical, not a room), finish tiles|spc|none}], walls [{x,y,w,h}] (inner walls as rectangles), doors [{x,y,len,v,hinge,swing,open}] (v: true = in a vertical wall, opening runs down from y; false = horizontal wall, runs right from x; hinge "start" (default, at x,y) or "end"; swing 1 = opens toward +x/+y, -1 = toward -x/-y; open false = shown closed; the user edits these in the widget), windows [{x,y,len,v,label,sill_cm,height_cm}] on the outer edge (x=0 / x=W / y=0 / y=H), fixed [{name,x,y,w,h}] (stairs, shower), furniture [{name,x,y,w,h,height_cm,elev_cm,kind,type}] (type = 3D/2D model id: sofa, sofa_corner, armchair, coffee_table, tv_stand, table, chair, kitchen, island, bed, nightstand, wardrobe, dresser, desk, shelf, toilet, toilet_wall, bidet, sink (two basins from 110 cm), kitchen_sink, kitchen_oven (oven housing base unit), range (freestanding oven with cooktop), kitchen_wall (wall unit), kitchen_tall (tall unit / fridge housing), bathtub, shower, shower_walkin, fridge, washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven, hob, hood, microwave, boiler, water_heater, tv, ac, radiator, towel_radiator, robot; omitted = guessed from the name; the back of the model faces the nearest wall) — furniture and appliances in one list: kind "appliance" for equipment (fridge, washer, dishwasher, oven, hob, hood, boiler, water heater, TV, air conditioner, radiator), height_cm = the item's own height, elev_cm = how high it is mounted above the floor (wall TV ≈100, boiler ≈120, hood ≈150, AC ≈220, hob on the counter 90); give height_cm for every item. presets [{name, items:[same fields]}] (ready furniture variants). Build it from a drawing or photos of the floor plan; names in the user's language. Merging: floors are matched by position (or index); a floor you send replaces the fields you give, other fields and floors stay — so to move furniture send only [{index, furniture}]. replace: true replaces the whole layout. The open plan picks it up within a minute. Returns rooms derived from the layout — pass them to recalc_plan if the user wants materials recalculated from the layout.
name: save_layout
title: Save floor layout
